name: @app/desktop
description: The desktop app (Mac, Windows, Linux): an Electron window showing the website from apps/web.

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && concurrently -k -n web,desktop -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix ../web run dev" "wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron . --dev"
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && npm --prefix ../web run build && electron .
scripts.lint: node --check main.cjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check scripts/ensure-electron.cjs
scripts.typecheck: node --check main.cjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check scripts/ensure-electron.cjs
